newsitem.title: USA: Universal Outdoor sets Baltimore market deal.
newsitem.headline: Universal Outdoor sets Baltimore market deal.

text.p: Universal Outdoor Inc said Wednesday it entered into a letter of intend to acquire the Baltimore market of Penn Advertising from Lamar Advertising Co.
Lamar, an outdoor advertising company, has signed a definitive agreement to buy Penn Advertising for about $167 million in cash.
Universal, which is also an outdoor advertising company, said the purchase will be structured as a stock acquisition of Penn's Baltimore subsidiary at a purchase price of $46.5 million.
Universal Outdoor said it expects to complete the agreement upon Lamar's consummation of its Penn acquisition.
The transaction is subject to the execution of a definitive purchase agreement as well as receipt of regulatory approval under Hart-Scott-Rodino and other customary closing conditions.

Universal will acquire about 1,450 display faces in the Baltimore metropolitan area. The company current has about 31,200 advertising display faces in 23 Midwestern, Southeastern and East Coast markets.
